insight: rp-core quality-fixer dispatcher fails at Phase 1 in this repo: no .claude/quality.json and no root package.json, so its npm fallback ENOENTs; run the declared gate `npm --prefix frontend run check` directly instead.

`biome check .` runs with cwd=frontend so supabase/functions/** is never linted/formatted by the standard gate; tsc only reaches those modules when a frontend test imports them. Lint Edge Function changes explicitly with --config-path=frontend.

This repo has no root package.json and no .claude/quality.json, so the rp-core dispatcher fallback cannot run; the real gate is `npm --prefix frontend run check` + `npm --prefix frontend run build` from repo root.
